description: A four-oscillator wavetable voice: AIR, WATER, EARTH and FIRE at the points of a pentagram, cross-modulated round the ring and in opposing pairs, through a ladder filter into a stereo delay

params.text: Sets the pitch of the AIR oscillator in semitones about C4, and the root the chord is built from while SPIRIT is engaged
Sets the pitch of that oscillator in semitones about C4; with SPIRIT engaged the chord sets the pitch instead
Moves that oscillator through its wavetable, from the first wave to the last
Scrolls through 24 chord voicings for the four oscillators, and does nothing until SPIRIT is engaged
Engages the fifth element: the four oscillators stop taking their own pitch knobs and become a four-note chord built on AIR
Sets how the wavetable is scanned across all four oscillators, from smooth morphing between waves anticlockwise to hard stepped switching clockwise
Cross-modulates round the elemental ring from AIR to WATER to FIRE to EARTH and back, phase modulation anticlockwise and frequency modulation clockwise, with wavefolding at either extreme
Ring-modulates the opposing pairs, AIR against FIRE and WATER against EARTH, mixing the result in as it is turned up
Spreads the four oscillators in detune and in stereo width
Calls one of 72 daemons, each a complete voice configuration, crossfading smoothly from the one before
Dials one of 64 deterministic variations on the daemon, shifting its cutoff, delay time and other offsets
Sets the corner of the 4-pole ladder lowpass, from 20Hz to the top of the audio band
Sets the resonance of the ladder lowpass, up into self-oscillation at the top of its travel
Sets the delay time, a quarter of the daemon's base time at the bottom of the knob and four times it at the top
Raises the feedback and the diffusion of the delay together, and widens the frequency shift in its feedback path
Blends the delay and diffusion against the dry voice
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the jack beside it before it is added to the control it belongs to

inputs.text: Transposes all four oscillators, a volt to the octave, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Moves the ring cross-modulation, 5V sweeping its whole range, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Moves the detune and stereo spread, 10V sweeping its whole range, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Moves the opposing-pair ring modulation, 10V sweeping its whole range, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Scans all 72 daemons over 10V, scaled by the trimmer beside it, and takes the choice away from the knob while a cable is patched
Moves the wavetable scan character, 10V sweeping its whole range, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Sweeps all 64 variations over 10V, scaled by the trimmer beside it, and adds to the knob rather than replacing it
Sweeps all 24 chord voicings over 10V, scaled by the trimmer beside it, and does nothing until SPIRIT is engaged
Moves that oscillator's wavetable position, 10V sweeping its whole range, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Moves the delay time, 10V sweeping its whole range, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Moves the delay feedback and diffusion, 10V sweeping its whole range, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Moves the filter corner a volt to the octave, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Moves the filter resonance, 10V sweeping its whole range, scaled by the trimmer beside it

outputs.text: The left channel of the voice, ±5V; with the right output unpatched this jack carries the two channels summed to mono
The right channel of the voice, ±5V

notes: with no cable in the V/OCT jack the four pitch knobs are the only thing setting pitch, so it makes sound the moment it is added to a patch
the daemon knob is the fastest way round this module: each of the 72 settings is a whole voice configuration, and the other knobs then shape it
